question: Diwan-i Kohi was the department of________ introduced by Muhammad Bin Tughlaq.
solution:
The correct answer is __**agriculture**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Diwan-i Kohi** was a department of **agriculture** introduced by Muhammad Bin Tughlaq.
 
• This department was responsible for the development and management of agriculture in the empire.
 
• Muhammad Bin Tughlaq established Diwan-i Kohi to improve agricultural productivity and ensure food security.
 
• The department took measures such as providing loans to farmers, introducing new agricultural techniques, and improving irrigation systems.
 
• Diwan-i Kohi played a crucial role in the agrarian reforms initiated by Muhammad Bin Tughlaq during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Bin Tughlaq** was the Sultan of Delhi from 1325 to 1351.
 
• He was known for his ambitious projects and reforms, which included efforts to centralize administration and improve the economy.
 
• Despite his innovative ideas, many of his projects, including those related to agriculture, faced challenges and were not always successful.
 
• His reign is often studied for its attempts at modernization and the complexities of implementing large-scale reforms.
